style: 16-bit Super Nintendo fighting game sprite art in the style of mid-90s Capcom arcade ports, crisp pixel art, limited palette, strong dark outline, cel shading with three tones, no anti-aliasing blur
sprite_bg: plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no border, single character only, entire body visible with empty margin around it

characters.fable: CLAUDE FABLE 5.1: a tall, stoic scholar-knight. Long flowing cream-white hair, calm serious face, warm light skin. Wears a long terracotta-orange (#D97757) robe split at the legs, a dark plum-brown leather safety harness strapped diagonally across the chest, dark plum-brown trousers and boots, a glowing orange eight-point asterisk sigil on the chest, and a sealed leather storybook chained to the hip.
characters.opus: CLAUDE OPUS 5.5: an elegant orchestra conductor. Swept-back silver hair, sharp refined face, light skin. Wears a deep navy (#1F2A55) tailcoat with long coat tails, white shirt front, coral (#E07A5F) bow tie and cuffs, navy trousers, black shoes, and holds a thin white conductor's baton in the front hand.
characters.astra: GPT-6 ASTRA: a towering cosmic emperor. Pale skin, white hair, glowing yellow eyes, a small gold crown and a floating ring of stars like a halo behind the head. Wears black (#1A1A2E) ornate armor with gold (#E8B838) trim, big gold shoulder pauldrons, gold gauntlets and greaves, a hexagonal flower emblem on the chest, and a long black cape speckled with white stars.
characters.sol: GPT-6 SOL: a fast, cheerful young sprinter. Tan skin, spiky sun-yellow hair shaped like sun rays, yellow headband with trailing tails. Wears an orange (#FF8A1E) tracksuit with a white zipper stripe, yellow sneakers, a sun emblem on the chest, and a small cape shaped like a price tag reading $2/$10.
characters.grok: GROK 4.7: a big swaggering brawler, broad and heavy. Light skin, black undercut hair, glowing red visor sunglasses. Wears a black leather biker jacket with a dark collar, a large white X emblem on the chest, dark blue denim jeans, black boots, fingerless gloves.
characters.gemini: GEMINI 3.8 FLASH: a small, hyper-fast young ninja girl. Light skin, long navy-blue twin tails, anxious determined eyes. Wears a blue (#4A5AE8) ninja outfit, violet (#A04AE8) gloves and a long violet scarf flowing behind, violet boots, and a glowing cyan four-point sparkle emblem on the chest.
characters.deepseek: DEEPSEEK V4: a calm, frugal martial-arts monk. Light-tan skin, serene face. Wears a deep blue (#1F4FA8) hooded robe where the hood is shaped like a whale head with a small dorsal fin and whale eyes, a white sash, dark navy trousers, bare feet with wraps, and a white whale emblem on the chest.
characters.qwen: QWEN 3.8: a hyperactive purple idol-ninja shapeshifter. Light skin, indigo bob haircut with one antenna-like strand of hair sticking up. Wears a purple (#6A3AE0) fitted outfit with lavender (#C8A8FF) trim, lavender boots, dark indigo leggings, and a white Q emblem on the chest.
characters.kimi: KIMI K3: a giant armored mech-ninja, the biggest fighter. Fully armored with no visible skin: a rounded silver (#C8D0E0) helmet with a glowing pale-yellow horizontal visor and a crescent moon crest on top, huge silver shoulder pauldrons, midnight-blue (#1A1E3A) armored body suit, silver forearms and shin guards, and a glowing crescent moon emblem on the chest.
characters.mythos: MYTHOS 5.1: an ominous, unleashed dark twin of a scholar-knight. Wild spiky gold hair, pale lavender-grey skin, glowing gold eyes. Wears a long dark violet (#2A1040) robe split at the legs, near-black trousers and boots, a glowing gold eight-point asterisk sigil on the chest, and a black book chained to the hip with broken chains. No harness.

idle.desc: fighting stance facing right, fists raised in guard, knees slightly bent

walk_a.desc: walking forward facing right mid-stride, front leg forward, guard up

walk_b.desc: walking facing right with legs passing each other, guard up

crouch.desc: crouching low facing right, knees deeply bent, fists up in guard

jump.desc: jumping in mid-air facing right, knees tucked up to the chest

block.desc: standing block facing right, forearms crossed in front of the face, leaning back

block_low.desc: crouching block facing right, forearms crossed in front, knees deeply bent

hit.desc: getting punched in the face, head snapped back, staggering backward, facing right

hit_gut.desc: hit in the stomach, doubled over forward in pain, facing right

fall.desc: knocked flying backward through the air, body horizontal, limbs flailing

lying.desc: lying flat on the back on the ground, knocked out, head to the left

jab.desc: quick jab punch facing right, front arm fully extended straight forward at head height

windup.desc: winding up a heavy punch facing right, punching arm pulled back

straight.desc: powerful lunging straight punch facing right, arm fully extended forward, body leaning in

kick.desc: front kick facing right, one leg extended straight forward at stomach height

high_kick.desc: high roundhouse kick facing right, one leg extended at head height, body leaning back

crouch_punch.desc: crouching low punch facing right, knees deeply bent, one arm extended forward

uppercut.desc: rising uppercut facing right, one fist thrust straight up overhead, jumping upward

sweep.desc: low sweep kick facing right, crouched with one leg extended straight along the ground

air_kick.desc: flying jump kick in mid-air facing right, one leg extended diagonally forward and down

air_punch.desc: mid-air diving punch facing right, arm punching diagonally downward, knees tucked

cast.desc: throwing an energy projectile facing right, both palms thrust forward, wide lunging stance

dash.desc: dashing forward facing right, leaning low and far forward, one arm stretched ahead

spin.desc: spinning lariat facing the viewer, both arms stretched straight out to the sides

charge.desc: powering up facing right, crouched in a wide stance, fists clenched at the sides

counter.desc: parry stance facing right, one open palm raised forward defensively

raise.desc: summoning facing right, one arm raised straight overhead

dizzy.desc: dazed and dizzy, wobbling, arms hanging loose, head tilted, facing right

win.desc: victory pose facing right, one fist raised triumphantly overhead

taunt.desc: confident taunt facing right, pointing forward at the opponent

lose.desc: defeated, kneeling on one knee with head hanging down, facing right

stages.archive: The Sealed Archive: a warm candlelit grand library interior at night with tall wooden bookshelves full of colorful books, arched windows showing a park, a huge round bronze vault door in the center wall crossed by chains, a small blue vending machine selling tungsten cubes, a terracotta rug on polished wooden floorboards
stages.goldengate: Golden Gate at dusk: a wooden pier in San Francisco at sunset, the red-orange Golden Gate Bridge across the bay, purple and orange sky, low fog drifting over the water, small sailboats, a cheering crowd along the railing, wooden plank floor
stages.stargate: Stargate, Abilene: a vast desert data center campus at sunset in Texas, rows of grey server halls with blinking lights, steaming cooling towers, power lines, red mesas on the horizon, construction workers in hard hats watching, dusty orange dirt ground
stages.launch: The Launch Stream: a dark tech product-launch livestream studio stage with a giant LED screen showing a bar chart, spotlights, stage lights truss, potted plants, stools, an audience of developers, glossy dark stage floor
stages.colossus: Colossus, Memphis: an industrial supercomputer site at night, huge data center building, gas turbines puffing smoke, a tall silver rocket on a launch tower in the distance, city skyline with lit windows, chain-link fence, concrete ground with yellow and black hazard stripes
stages.shoreline: Shoreline Keynote: a sunny outdoor tech keynote amphitheater with white peaked tent canopies, a giant keynote video screen, clusters of blue red yellow and green balloons, cheering crowd, blue sky with fluffy clouds, grey stage floor
stages.westlake: West Lake, Hangzhou at night: a calm lake reflecting the moon, a lit multi-tier pagoda on a hill, red paper lanterns, weeping willow trees, starry dark blue sky, grey stone causeway floor
stages.market: Singles' Day night market in Hangzhou: neon signs with 11.11, colorful striped market stall awnings, strings of lights, paper lanterns, neon city buildings, a busy crowd, checkered purple tile floor
stages.moon: Moonshot Crater: the grey cratered lunar surface under a black starry sky, the blue Earth rising above the horizon, a small golden lunar lander and a flag with a crescent moon, distant grey mountains
stages.vault: The Vault, opened: a dark violet magical vault interior with glowing gold runes on stone columns, a huge open round vault door pouring golden light, broken chains, floating books, dark stone floor with glowing lines
